summary: Electronics enclosure: an open base box with four corner screw bosses and a flat lid held by four M3 screws
assumptions: Bosses Ø8 in the inside corners, touching both walls; screws M3 x 10 socket head into tapped bosses.

subassemblies.name: Enclosure
subassemblies.description: The base box with the lid screwed on top.

parts.name: Enclosure base
parts.description: ABS base box 120 x 80 x 40 mm, 2.5 mm walls and floor, open at the top, four Ø8 screw bosses in the inside corners, each tapped M3 (Ø2.5 tap drill) 8 mm deep from the rim.

parts.name: Enclosure lid
parts.description: Flat ABS lid 120 x 80 x 3 mm with four Ø3.4 clearance holes over the bosses.

parts.name: Lid screw M3x10
parts.description: ISO 4762 socket head cap screw M3 x 10 through the lid into a boss.
